# Grandstand CrossFit

> Grandstand CrossFit (also known as Grandstand Fitness) is a coached group
> training gym at 92 Parry Street, Perth WA 6000, Australia — on the edge of
> the Perth CBD near HBF Park, serving East Perth, Highgate, Northbridge,
> Mount Lawley and Leederville. Founded in 2014 by Matt Evans and Justin
> Samulski. Slogan: "Great Culture. Grand Outcomes." — a culture built on
> CrossFit.

Grandstand is open 7 days a week and offers CrossFit classes (the core
program), a Sunday Hyrox session, Olympic weightlifting,
open gym for members, personal training and kids fitness.
Every class is coach-led and scaled to the individual, from complete beginners
to competitive athletes. The first session is a free trial.

Key facts:
- Address: 92 Parry Street, Perth WA 6000, Australia
- Phone: 0424 476 235 (+61 424 476 235)
- Email: info@grandstandcrossfit.com.au
- Hours: open 7 days a week — Mon–Fri 5:30am–7:30pm, Sat 6:30–11:00am, Sun 8:00–11:00am
- Weekly schedule: 8 CrossFit classes every weekday (5:30am–6:00pm); Olympic weightlifting Wednesday 6:00pm and Saturday 9:30am; Hyrox session Sunday 9:00am (a supplement — the core program is CrossFit); open gym weekdays 10:30am and 1:30pm and Sunday 8:00am
- Memberships: Unlimited (all classes, specialty sessions and open gym), 3x/week, 2x/week with FIFO-friendly flexibility; visitor drop-in unlimited week $80
- Programming: 6–8 week strength and conditioning blocks written by Cameron Joseph of Overpowered Athletics; weekly "Terrible Tuesday" traditional CrossFit workout; delivered by CrossFit Level 2 head coach Jack Roberts and a team of qualified CrossFit trainers; gym management and membership support by Shez Lee
- Kids creche: gated kids creche area with a child-proof lock inside the gym (bean bags, toys, chalkboard, Netflix) so parents can train while kids play — a key point of difference
- Founded: 2014
- Instagram: @grandstandcrossfit · Facebook: /grandstandcf
